content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity), § 13.1.**

- **Issue:** The operative Services grant in 13.1 hits nearly all walk-away triggers — revocable at Vendor's sole discretion, limited to "Customer alone," expressly excluding Affiliates and contractors, and non-transferable.
- **Context:** 13.2 (paid-up perpetual/irrevocable licence covering Affiliates and contractors) and 13.3 (transfer to Affiliate/successor; revocation only for material uncured breach after notice and cure) already match our preferred position, so 13.1 is both off-playbook and internally inconsistent.
- **Redline (validated, preferred level):** grant extended to Customer and its Affiliates, contractors acting on our behalf permitted, transferability tied to 13.3, and revocation/suspension limited to the 13.3 notice-and-cure standard. 13.4 restrictions left untouched.
